subject.title: [Bug]: agent --json returns pre-hook assistant text instead of finalized before_message_write output

question: When `before_message_write` rewrites or blocks the final CLI assistant message, what should `agent --json` expose to callers?
rationale: The code can be repaired narrowly, but the blocked-message result shape is a security and compatibility choice because current tests preserve raw payload output even when transcript persistence is blocked.

options.title: Do not expose raw blocked content
options.body: Return rewritten post-hook text when available and use an empty or structured blocked result when the hook blocks the message, then update CLI tests and live proof around that contract.

options.title: Preserve current raw JSON output
options.body: Keep the current behavior for compatibility, accepting that plugin persistence hooks do not govern `agent --json` output.

options.title: Defer to broader hook architecture
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the broader outbound hook unification work instead of making a per-surface CLI fix now.

recommendation.title: Do not expose raw blocked content
recommendation.body: Return rewritten post-hook text when available and use an empty or structured blocked result when the hook blocks the message, then update CLI tests and live proof around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original hook feature and is the best available routing owner for deciding whether the hook boundary should govern CLI JSON output.
